methodology.purpose: Keep the fixed V9+ random-stock-split test unchanged, then add PB-V23 add-on conditions only.
methodology.fixed_entry: V9+ entry is fixed: abc_fast / market all / weekly all / monthly trend / signal controlled / top_n 0.
methodology.addon_logic: PB-V23 focus add-on logic: MA20 retest, max5/spacing5, scan to available data end, loose-confluence structural close stop with next-open execution, and 15% close-based catastrophic line.
methodology.split: Same 10 seeds and same stock-code 60/20/20 split method as pullback_v9_fixed_random_splits. No rule or exit re-selection per seed.
methodology.costs: V9+ gross framework retained; no additional V18 stress cost is applied to V9 add-ons.

addon_variant.label: 獨立生命週期：最多5次加碼，間隔5日
